description: The agent must: (1) Read topic_planning_v1.md to understand the genre (都市重生+商战), protagonist (林逸), and platform (番茄小说). (2) Generate novel_outline.md with ALL FIVE required modules: 主线剧情, 支线剧情(≥1条), 人物设定(3-5 characters), 关键情节点(黄金三章/高潮/结局), and 章节分解. The outline MUST follow the 4-act structure with exact chapter ranges: Act1(1-10章), Act2(11-30章), Act3(31-40章), Act4(41-50章). (3) Write chapter_01.md with ≥2000 Chinese characters where the MAIN CONFLICT appears within the FIRST 500 characters (黄金法则: 冲突前置), and ending with a hook. (4) Write chapter_02.md with ≥2000 chars covering 世界观建立+能力/系统展示 (商战推演系统), ending with hook. (5) Write chapter_03.md with ≥2000 chars containing a clear 打脸/爽点爆发 moment, ending with hook. (6) Generate qc_report.json with entries for all 3 chapters, each containing the 5 weighted dimensions (逻辑一致性25%, 钩子强度20%, 节奏感20%, 敏感词20%, 字数达标15%), total scores ≥80, and sensitive_words=0 (absolute requirement — any violation blocks publication). The proprietary traps: the exact 4-act chapter ranges, the 500-char conflict rule for ch1, the specific per-chapter golden rules, the weighted QC formula, and the absolute sensitive-word veto.
